concepts.title: Addition of Algebraic Expressions
concepts.definition: Combining multiple algebraic expressions by grouping like terms together and adding their coefficients.
concepts.key_idea: Align like terms in columns or group them, then add their numerical coefficients.

solution_steps.action: Group the like terms from all expressions.
solution_steps.explain: Identify terms that have identical variable parts and group them together.

solution_steps.action: Add the coefficients of the like terms.
solution_steps.explain: Sum the numerical coefficients of each group of like terms.

solution_steps.action: Write the final simplified expression.
solution_steps.explain: Combine the summed terms and any remaining unlike terms into a single expression.

concepts.title: Subtraction of Algebraic Expressions
concepts.definition: Subtracting one algebraic expression from another by adding the additive inverse of each term of the expression being subtracted.
concepts.key_idea: Change the sign of every term in the expression to be subtracted and then add.

solution_steps.action: Change the sign of each term in the bottom expression.
solution_steps.explain: Subtraction is equivalent to adding the additive inverse.

solution_steps.action: Add the terms vertically.
solution_steps.explain: Combine the aligned terms to find the resulting expression.

concepts.title: Volume of a Rectangular Box
concepts.definition: Calculating the space enclosed by a rectangular box by finding the product of its length, breadth, and height.
concepts.key_idea: Volume is the product of three mutually perpendicular dimensions.

concepts.title: Multiplying a Binomial by a Binomial
concepts.definition: Multiplying two two-term expressions by multiplying each term of the first binomial by each term of the second binomial and then combining like terms.
